impact: A rough day for NBIS (about -16%) and softer for MU and DRAM, while GOOGL held up. Rising yields and December hike odds hit small caps hardest; PPI on Friday is next.
summary: Stocks gave up an afternoon bounce and closed lower Thursday. The S&P 500 fell 0.35% to 7,592.40, the Dow 0.36% to 52,297.09 and the Nasdaq 0.39% to 25,366.09, while the Russell 2000 dropped about 1.66%. Nvidia closed down 4.34% at $166.19 after falling as much as 14% at the open on Huang's resignation. Nebius fell about 16% to around $129 after its Q3 report, and Micron was down about $18 near $793 midday. Energy, Broadcom, AMD, Alphabet and Amazon gained.
title: Stocks close lower: S&P -0.35%, Nasdaq -0.39%; Nvidia -4.3%, Nebius ~-16%
